subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial intake & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@acme.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for procurement review

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well — procurement at Acme is kicking off our vendor security review for Q1 and we need to collect SOC 2 Type II artifacts for vendors in scope. Can you confirm if Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the inference hosting service and provide: 

- A copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or a bridge letter if the current report period doesn't cover our desired window
- Statement of the audit period (start/end dates)
- A short list of sample artifacts we could request (logs, change management evidence, access reviews)
- Preferred secure transfer method for sensitive files (SFTP, shared Drive link with DLP, or secure S3 presigned link)

We typically need the items by 2027-01-05 to meet our RFP timeline — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Grant
Senior Vendor Manager, Acme Corp
A: alyssa@acme.com

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for procurement review

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick answer: yes, we can provide a Type II report and a bridge letter. Below is a short mutual action plan (MAP) and what we typically share for initial intake. I copied Ben (sales) and Monica (security/CS) to coordinate delivery and any follow-ups.

1) Audit period: our latest Type II report covers 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30. If you require coverage into Q4 2026 we can provide a bridge letter that documents controls continuity from 2026-10-01 to the present; bridge letter typically accompanies the last full Type II report.

2) Mutual action plan (high level):
   - Day 0 (today): Redwood confirms report availability and preferred transfer method.
   - Day 1: Acme returns the signed DPA/engagement letter (if required) or confirms point of contact for secure transfer.
   - Day 2–3: Redwood posts the Type II report and bridge letter to an access-controlled Drive folder and shares presigned S3 link as backup.
   - Day 4: Acme confirms receipt; follow-up requests for limited artifacts scheduled (we can provide samples, redacted logs, and evidence indexes).

3) Typical artifacts we provide on initial intake (we keep PII out of initial bundle):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
   - Bridge letter (if requested)
   - SOC 2 coverage matrix (controls mapped to Redwood products/environments)
   - Evidence index (names of collected artifacts and availability window)
   - Redacted sample: change management ticket, user access review summary, and a one-page infra diagram

4) Secure transfer options (preferred order):
   - Shared Drive folder (Google Workspace) with restricted link + Data Loss Prevention rules and viewer-only access.
   - Presigned S3 object link with one-week expiry and IP restriction.
   - Encrypted SFTP dropbox (for customers on air-gapped or higher-compliance flows).

5) Templates and attachments: I attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf) and our MAP template (mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx).

6) Timeline: we can meet your 2027-01-05 deadline if we receive a confirmation on transfer method and point of contact by 2026-12-22.

Sample quick-reply templates you can use internally: 
   - Procurement to vendor: \"Confirmed. Please share via secure Drive link and send POA to security@acme.com.\"
   - Security to vendor: \"Please include evidence index and any redaction guidance. We will request specific artifacts within five business days of receipt.\"

If you'd like, Monica can set up the secure folder and Ben can send an official GTC/DPA pointer. 

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@acme.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-21T11:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for procurement review

Thanks, Jonas — that roadmap is helpful. A couple clarifications before we proceed:

- We will accept the Drive folder approach (Google Workspace) but request viewer-only plus download disabled where possible. If you can also provide a presigned S3 fallback that would be preferred for the documents we need to archive.
- We need the audit period explicitly written in the report metadata — the dates you listed are fine, please ensure the bridge letter states the covered range and the controls continuity statement.
- On artifacts: we may request a redacted access review and a sample of change-control evidence (ticket id + summary) — redacting user IDs is fine.

Procurement has authorized an internal POA: procurement@acme.com will confirm receipt and the approver name. We should be able to return confirmation by 2026-12-22.

One last ask: Do you have a short statement we can use in our vendor risk register indicating whether Redwood retains production data or has any processing of customer data in shared indexes? A one-liner is fine.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alyssa

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-22T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for procurement review

Alyssa — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the Drive approach. Quick answers inline: 

- Drive folder: we'll create a viewer-only folder and enable download disable where your tenant and Drive policy permit. We'll also generate a presigned S3 link as an alternate.
- Audit period: the PDF metadata and cover note will include the dates 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30; the bridge letter will state continuity from 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-22 (date of issuance).
- One-line vendor register statement (feel free to copy): "Redwood Inference does not retain customer production data in shared indexes; customer data is stored in tenant-isolated storage and processed only for inference requests under customer-configured retention policies."

Action items we will complete by EOD 2026-12-23:
 - Monica to create Drive folder and post redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf + full report PDF and bridge letter (if requested).
 - Ben to provide contract pointer and any necessary DPA language.
 - Jonas to share MAP and evidence index.

If anything changes on your side, let us know; otherwise we'll assume procurement@acme.com will confirm the transfer method by tomorrow and we'll proceed.

Best regards,
Jonas
